description:
Wire the existing cli_outbound module to UI controls so the frontend can issue user actions.

=== Scope ===

Per ARCH §3.4 / §3.5: user actions are exclusively 'lernie <subcommand>' invocations. cli_outbound (bl-02da) already exists; this task is the UI side that calls it.

Buttons:
- New prompt: text input + submit, invokes 'lernie prompt --repo <path> -- <text>'. Exact subcommand surface is pinned by the lernie CLI; if a needed subcommand doesn't exist yet, surface that and either coordinate with the CLI owner or file a blocker.
- Stop: targets a selected branch / in-flight step, invokes the corresponding lernie subcommand.
- Resume: reciprocal of stop on a stopped branch.

Rules:
- No persistent UI state (§3.5). Selection lives in memory; everything reproducible from filesystem.
- All commands go through cli_outbound::run; no direct Command::new in the UI module.
- Disabled-button states derive from view-model (e.g. Stop disabled when no in-flight branch selected).

=== Tests ===

- View-model unit: button enabled/disabled bits derive correctly from fixture repos.
- Integration: a fake 'lernie' on PATH (shell stub, no mocking) records its argv; clicking each button produces the expected argv.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: UI: user-action buttons wired through cli_outbound (new prompt / stop / resume)
